items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Well, then after my brother left Joe Robichaud, he started playing with Peter

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, how old is your little brother?

Well, my little brother, he was about forty-nine when he died. Mm-hmm. Oh, he played with the best of them, him. He played, he left here one time, he went with, uh, went with the Banner Band, New Ivery, stayed up there about a year. He came back and him and Freddie Coleman and, uh, went with Joe Robichaud. Well, they started traveling a while, him and Freddie, with Joe Robichaud. They went all up New York, Mexico, and all about. And all they traveling, when they got back here, they didn't have a dime. They said,…
Pete ought to show him how to save money, huh?
